about_the_game:
Game Overview

MATCH APP! is a visual novel game based on a Japanese dating app. Players take on the role of the protagonist and experience a story of new encounters through the dating app.

Story

The protagonist, Masayan, is a university senior about to graduate. Encouraged by his friend Hiroshi, Masayan decides to dive into the world of dating apps. For the shy Masayan, everything is a first experience, and he's constantly confused... Will Masayan be able to "match" with a woman?

Characters

Masayan (CV: Ono Ryutaro)

The protagonist of the story. A university senior who has never had a proper romantic relationship during his college life. He starts using a matchmaking app at Hiroshi’s suggestion.

Hiroshi (CV:Kugui Urielia)

Masayan’s roommate and friend. One day, he recommends a dating app to Masayan and supports him in his romantic journey.

Kumoko (CV: Takekawa Kaede)

A woman who matched with Masayan on the app. Although she doesn’t have much dating experience, she takes a very proactive approach.

Game Information

Playtime: 1 hour-2 hours

Full Voice (Japanese Voice)

10 CGs

Multiple endings
